events.title: 송악에서 태어나다
events.description: 송악의 호족 왕륭의 아들로 태어났다. 송악은 예성강과 가까운 무역 요지였다.
events.description_en: He was born the son of Wang Yung, a local magnate of Songak. Songak was a trading hub close to the Yeseong River.

events.title: 아버지와 함께 궁예에게 귀부해 성주가 되다
events.title_en: He submitted to Gungye with his father and became lord of the fortress
events.description: 아버지 왕륭과 함께 궁예에게 송악을 바치고 귀부했다. 스무 살의 왕건은 성주로 임명되어 궁예의 조정에 들어섰다.
events.description_en: Together with his father Wang Yung, he offered Songak to Gungye and submitted to him. At twenty he was named lord of the fortress and entered Gungye's court.

events.title: 시중에 오르다
events.description: 잇단 전공을 인정받아 궁예 조정의 백관을 이끄는 시중에 올랐다.
events.description_en: In recognition of his repeated victories in the field, he rose to chief minister, head of the officials at Gungye's court.

events.title: 궁예를 몰아내고 태조로 즉위해 고려를 세우다
events.title_en: He deposed Gungye and founded Goryeo as its first king
events.description: 신숭겸, 배현경 등 측근 장수들의 추대를 받아 군사를 일으켜 궁예를 몰아냈다. 철원 포정전에서 왕위에 올라 나라 이름을 고려로 정했다.
events.description_en: Backed by officers such as Sin Sung-gyeom and Bae Hyeon-gyeong, he raised troops and drove out Gungye. He took the throne at Pojeong Hall in Cheorwon and named the new state Goryeo.

events.title: 도읍을 송악으로 옮기다
events.title_en: He moved the capital to Songak
events.description: 철원에서 자신의 근거지인 송악으로 도읍을 옮겼다. 이 자리가 훗날 개경이 된다.
events.description_en: He moved the capital from Cheorwon to Songak, his own home base. This site later became known as Gaegyeong.

events.title: 견훤이 투항해오다
events.description: 아들 신검에게 쫓겨난 후백제 왕 견훤이 고려로 투항해왔다. 왕건은 그를 받아들였다.
events.description_en: Gyeon Hwon, king of Later Baekje, was driven out by his own son Singeom and defected to Goryeo. Wang Geon received him.

events.title: 신라 경순왕이 항복하다
events.title_en: King Gyeongsun of Silla surrendered to him
events.description: 신라의 마지막 왕 경순왕이 나라를 들어 스스로 항복해왔다. 천년 사직 신라가 문을 닫았다.
events.description_en: King Gyeongsun, the last ruler of Silla, surrendered his kingdom of his own will. A thousand years of Silla came to an end.

events.title: 일리천에서 후백제를 무너뜨리고 후삼국을 통일하다
events.title_en: He crushed Later Baekje at Ilicheon and reunified the Three Kingdoms
events.description: 일선군 일리천을 사이에 두고 후백제군과 최후의 결전을 벌여 승리했다. 이로써 신라 말 이래 갈라졌던 후삼국을 하나로 합쳤다.
events.description_en: He fought a final decisive battle against the Later Baekje army across the Ilicheon River near Ilseon and won. With this victory he reunited the Later Three Kingdoms that had splintered apart since the fall of Silla's golden age.

events.title: 훈요십조를 남기다
events.title_en: He left behind the Ten Injunctions
events.description: 죽기 전 후대 왕들이 지킬 열 가지 훈계인 훈요십조를 몸소 지어 박술희에게 전했다.
events.description_en: Before his death he personally wrote the Ten Injunctions, a set of guidelines for future kings, and entrusted them to Bak Sul-hui.

events.title: 개경에서 눈감다
events.description: 고려를 세우고 후삼국을 통일한 뒤 도읍 개경에서 예순일곱에 숨을 거두었다.
events.description_en: Having founded Goryeo and reunified the Three Kingdoms, he died in the capital Gaegyeong at the age of sixty-seven.
